question: In India, the monsoon lasts for ______ days from early June to mid-September.
solution:
The correct answer is __**100 - 120.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• **Monsoons** are **seasonal winds** that **reverse their course** in response to the onset of a new season. 
 
• The **Arabic term** for season,** "mawsim,"** is thought to be the source of the word "monsoon."
 
• It is maintained in the region between** 20 °N and 20 °S.**
 
• **It lasts for 100–120 days, starting in early June and ending in mid-September.**
 
• India receives about **80% of its annual rainfall** during the monsoon season.
 
• In India, 64% of the population makes their living from agriculture, which is reliant on the monsoon season.
 
• Rainfall during the monsoon season replenishes reservoirs and dams, which is then utilised to produce hydroelectric power.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__

 

 
• **Two types** of monsoon are as follows:

 
 
• The South-west monsoon is the primary rainy season in India, which starts in June and lasts till September.

 
 
• This monsoon is caused by the differential heating of land and sea, which results in the formation of low-pressure systems over the Indian Ocean and the Arabian Sea.
 
 
 
• The Retreating Monsoon, also known as the North-East monsoon, brings rainfall to the southern parts of India during October and November.
 
 
• This monsoon is caused by the withdrawal of the south-west monsoon winds and the formation of a low-pressure system over the Bay of Bengal.
 
 
 
 
 
• The **Indian Meteorological Department (IMD)** keeps a close eye on the start of the monsoon season to assist farmers in scheduling their farming operations.
